disposition_reason: Table 2 prints single cadmium, lead and mercury values for five canned and one fresh sardine product from the Libyan market.

study.design: market survey, one fresh and five canned sardine products
study.origin: canned products made in Libya, Malta, Morocco, Tunisia and Spain; fresh sardine from Sabratha, Libya
study.method: drying at 110 °C, HNO3/H2SO4/H2O2 hot-block digestion, AAS (PerkinElmer AAnalyst 800; abstract says graphite furnace after microwave digestion)
study.qa: no CRM, recovery or LOD reported; analysis by a commercial laboratory
